question: Indian classical vocalist Pandit Jasraj belonged to which of the following musical gharanas?
solution:
The correct answer is **Mewati Gharana**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Jasraj** was a revered figure in Indian classical music, known for his contributions to vocal music.
 
• He belonged to the **Mewati Gharana**, which is renowned for its distinctive approach to khayal, a form of Indian classical singing.
 
• The Mewati Gharana emphasizes **bhava** (emotion), clear pronunciation of words (sahitya), and a unique approach to raga development.
 
• Pandit Jasraj's style was marked by his innovative use of the merukhand technique, and his performances often included rare ragas, enriching the Indian classical music repertoire.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 1) Patiala Gharana
 Known for its emphasis on intricate taans and powerful voice projection.
 
 

 2) Dagari Gharana

 One of the oldest gharanas, it is respected for its balanced approach and versatility in khayal singing.
